summary: This document provides the implementation details of a custom GridView control in the HSPnet application, which includes paging functionalities such as toggling between showing all records and paged view.
purpose: To facilitate advanced paging functionalities in the HSPnet application using a custom GridView control.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.description: The starting row index of the current page in the grid.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.description: The number of records per page.

fields.name: PageCount
fields.description: The total number of pages available.

workflows.name: Paging Workflow
steps: Initialize pager with NextPrevNumericPagerTemplate using current page index and page count.
Calculate starting and ending page indices to display based on current page index and total page count.
Create navigation buttons (Next, Previous) and ellipsis buttons for page skipping.
Toggle paging using predefined default and max page sizes.
Update the toggle button text based on current paging status.

business_rules: Paging is toggled by setting the page size to a large value to disable paging or reset to default size for enabling paging.
The toggle button visibility is dependent on whether the pager is necessary.
validations: Ensure that the page size does not exceed maxPageSize or fall below defaultPageSize when toggling.
calculations: Derive the starting page index based on current position minus a specified range.
Determine if all records are being shown by comparing current page size with default and max sizes.
conditions: Check if current page size is less than maxPageSize before toggling to 'Show All'.
If page count is 1 and page size matches default, hide paging toggle button.
system_behavior: Adjusts the page navigation buttons and their states based on user interaction and page sizes.
dependencies: Relies on .NET WebForms control structures and event handling.
Integration with HSPnet application resources and UI components.
exceptions: If lbTogglePaging is null during caption toggle, the operation is bypassed.
